messages_fts:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "messages_fts" USING fts5(
                        "content",
                        content="messages",
                        content_rowid="store_id"
                    )
msg_fts_insert:
CREATE TRIGGER msg_fts_insert
                AFTER INSERT ON messages BEGIN
                INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content)
                    VALUES (new.store_id, new.content);
            END
msg_fts_delete:
CREATE TRIGGER msg_fts_delete
                AFTER DELETE ON messages BEGIN
                INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content)
                    VALUES('delete', old.store_id, old.content);
            END
msg_fts_update:
CREATE TRIGGER msg_fts_update
                AFTER UPDATE OF content ON messages BEGIN
                INSERT INTO messages_fts(messages_fts, rowid, content)
                    VALUES('delete', old.store_id, old.content);
                INSERT INTO messages_fts(rowid, content)
                    VALUES (new.store_id, new.content);
            END

            END
lcm_trajectory_fts_delete:

            AFTER DELETE ON lcm_trajectory_states BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lcm_trajectory_states_fts(lcm_trajectory_states_fts, rowid, search_text)

            END
lcm_trajectory_fts_update:

            AFTER UPDATE OF search_text ON lcm_trajectory_states BEGIN
                INSERT INTO lcm_trajectory_states_fts(lcm_trajectory_states_fts, rowid, search_text)
